claim: Public MS clinical-reference sources describe secondary progressive MS as a progressive course that follows an initial relapsing-remitting course in many patients.
future_grounding_route: Could be compared with future longitudinal disease-course metadata, but cannot be used as project evidence without a separate grounded analysis.
project_use: Public-reader disease-course context; not evidence for any project finding.

source.label: National MS Society secondary progressive MS page

why_unverifiable: The project cannot rerun a clinical society's public disease-course definitions from held data.
